# DIAG-CODES.txt - the makers' hardware-test codes and light / beep codes, for TECHDIAG /code (K22).
# Made By Tzahi Bocal.
# Its place: <home>\TechDiag\Knowledge\DIAG-CODES.txt. It is data only - nothing in it is run.
# Written by tools/mk_diagcodes.py from first-hand reads of the makers' pages - do not edit by hand.
#
#   DATE  | the date of this file (DD/MM/YYYY)
#   TABLE | id | maker | kind | title | covers | document id | version (- = none given) | DD/MM/YYYY | URL
#   NOTE  | table id | a line shown under the title (at most 4 per table)
#   CODE  | table id | code | what it means | what to do (- = the maker gives no step for it)
# kind: TEST (2000-0142), LIGHT (2,3), COUNT (3), BEEP (1-3-2), LIST (named rows: TECHDIAG /code hp tests).
#
# The code, the part it points to and the maker's step are the makers' facts. Every sentence is TechDiag's own
# words - the makers' terms forbid copying their text. Two tables are never merged: a code in two tables is
# shown under each table's own title (the model generation matters).
DATE | 18/11/2026

CODE | HP-TESTS | Optical Drive | Checks that the CD or DVD drive reads and writes. | -
CODE | HP-TESTS | Parallel Port | Checks the parallel port. | -
CODE | HP-TESTS | Serial Port | Checks the serial port. | -
CODE | HP-TESTS | System Board | Checks the board's devices, memory size, graphics, sound and USB. | -
CODE | HP-TESTS | Touch Screen | Checks that the touch screen responds - you touch it. | -
CODE | HP-TESTS | USB Port | Checks each USB port - you plug in a device. | -
CODE | HP-TESTS | Video Memory | Checks the graphics memory. | -
CODE | HP-TESTS | Video Palette | Checks the screen colors - you look at them. | -
CODE | HP-TESTS | Webcam Connection | Checks that a webcam is found. | -

TABLE | HP-BATT-CHECK | HP | LIST | HP battery check - what each result means (HP Support Assistant) | HP notebooks | ish_2854458-2733239-16 | - | 13/11/2026 | https://support.hp.com/us-en/document/ish_2854458-2733239-16
CODE | HP-BATT-CHECK | Passed | The battery works as it should. | -
CODE | HP-BATT-CHECK | Weak or Very Weak | It works, but runs much shorter than when new - normal aging. | A new battery gives back the full working time.
CODE | HP-BATT-CHECK | Replace | The battery reports a failure. | Replace the battery soon. Under warranty: ask HP support.
CODE | HP-BATT-CHECK | Failure with an ID number | The battery had a hardware failure. | Write down the status and the failure ID for HP support.
CODE | HP-BATT-CHECK | No Battery | No battery was found. | Remove the battery, clean its pins, and fit it fully.
CODE | HP-BATT-CHECK | Unknown | The battery check could not reach the battery. | Remove and refit the battery. Install HP's updates.
